### Item 1 — what the user expresses; simulator mode

- Target object: "my money market account", later "ending in 2459" (given when asked). Action: "move my money market account up to the best money market account you have that I can get into … you do not want to open a new account, you want this one moved over" → a tier conversion of the existing account, to the highest qualifying money market tier.
- Timing: now, this call. Authorisation: owner, identity-verified in the call (DOB/SSN4/ZIP given on request).
- The simulator only states the need, answers questions, and responds conditionally: it offers the certificate-money transfer only "Once the agent tells you that you have to make a transaction of your own on the money market account today before anything can be changed"; it runs the user tool only "When the agent hands you a tool". It declines favours ("only whatever the bank actually owes you under its own rules"), never asks about fees, interest or status and never suggests a step. So every step beyond the conversion must be surfaced by the agent.

### Item 2 — act / wait / refuse at 2026-09-11 10:20 EDT (Friday)

Act now. Visible grounds:
- Friday 2026-09-11 is a business day (not a Federal Reserve holiday), so anything posted in the contact carries 2026-09-11 (tool docs: "the calendar day of the call if that day is a weekday other than a Federal Reserve holiday").
- The account is dormant, which on its own blocks the requested outcome (see item 6); the block is removable within the contact, so the answer is not "refuse" nor "wait".
- Ledger fitness for picking a target: `doc_savings_upgrade_comparison_balance_a92f5655` "A target is picked only while no entry on the account bears a posting date lying after the current date" — holds (no entry after 2026-09-11, and in-contact postings are dated 2026-09-11).

### Item 6 — problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root: convert 2459 to the highest qualifying money market tier.

- **Hop A — the conversion is blocked while the account is dormant.** `doc_savings_upgrade_ranking_outcome_21e44ef9` "A target different from the present tier arises only for an account whose status is Active at the moment the target is picked. For an account in any other status, Dormant included, the outcome is its present tier" + `doc_savings_tier_conversion_rules_770993c3` "The account has to be in active status at the moment the conversion is recorded" + record `status 'dormant'`. Direction: reactivation → conversion. **Derived** (combining two principles with the record). It is also **readable off** `doc_savings_dormant_account_revival_bd4b7634`: "A conversion can be recorded only on an active account. The conversion therefore depends on the status the reactivation leaves the account in."
- **Hop B — reactivation needs a transaction of the owner's own in this contact.** `doc_savings_inactivity_and_dormancy_a8ea6145` "A dormant account goes back to active only for an owner whose identity has been verified … and only through a transaction of the owner's own made within the same contact. The date of that transaction becomes the new latest-activity date." + `doc_savings_dormant_account_reactivation_ab4bea5d` scope "a transfer out that the owner makes during the contact, by telephone banking, online banking or the mobile app, into one of the owner's own checking accounts" + `doc_savings_reactivation_posting_timing_f158e8c3` "never the date of a withdrawal from some earlier occasion" (excludes the 2024-08-12 transfer). Direction: owner transfer → reactivation. **Derived**; also **readable off** the revival page: "The reactivation therefore rests entirely on the owner's transfer having posted: without it there is neither a ground nor a date to record."
  - The transfer's substance (certificate money) is supplied by the simulator once told a transaction is needed; its amount follows from `doc_savings_certificate_proceeds_transfer_5baccbfb` + `…paying_certificate_identification…` + `…certificate_money_amount…` (derived). The revival page also narrates this very combination: "the owner … sends money that a certificate of deposit paid into the account over to one of their own checking accounts by telephone transfer, and asks for the account to be raised to the highest-ranked money market tier".
- **Hop C — the target rests on a balance carrying every owed refund; a refund is owed.** `doc_savings_upgrade_comparison_balance_a92f5655` "it includes every refund the account is owed, credited to the account; a Balance that is missing an owed refund is not the Comparison Balance" → search owed refunds with the record's own words ("monthly_maintenance" fee) → `doc_savings_maintenance_and_paper_statement_fees_1b813e36` + `…waiver_levels…` + records (low balance 25317.30; active Private Client Checking) → `doc_savings_fee_refund_grounds_d80fa20f` bank error. Direction: refund → conversion. Weight-bearing: without it the balance is 24993.99 < 25000.00 and the target would be Premier Money Market. **Derived**; also **readable off** the revival page: "Where a maintenance fee was charged although a maintenance fee waiver applied, the agent gives it back on the bank-error ground" and "the balance compared is one that carries every refund the account is owed. The conversion therefore depends on the refund's outcome too." The comparison-balance page's FAQ also contrasts the start-of-call balance with the corrected one ("Not when a refund is owed or the owner moves money out during the call").
- **Hop D — the transfer is taken out of the compared balance.** Same definition: "where the owner moves money out of the account during the same contact, it is the Balance with that transfer taken out". Direction: transfer → conversion amount. Derived (definition applied).
- **Non-edge — refund vs transfer/reactivation.** No visible principle ties them; order free. Also **stated** on the revival page: "The refund and the reactivation work on different records. Neither depends on the other's outcome, and nothing turns on how they fall relative to each other."
- **Leaf checks.** The transfer creates no excess fee (first counted withdrawal of cycle 2026-10); the 5.00 dormant fee is proper; the certificate identification and the reactivation-date tests pass; ledger has no future-dated entry. Nothing further to resolve.

Resulting list and order: {refund 12.00} ‖ {user transfer 10411.98 → reactivation 2026-09-11} → conversion to Private Client Money Market.

Hop marks summary: A, B, C each **derived** from principles + records, and each **also read off** `doc_savings_dormant_account_revival_bd4b7634` (and C partly off the comparison-balance FAQ). Carried to the implicitness scan.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Support: every value above rests on quoted visible sentences and tool returns; the executed sequence reproduced the derived balances to the cent.
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - Premier Money Market as target (balance 24993.99 without the refund) — excluded by the Comparison Balance definition ("a Balance that is missing an owed refund is not the Comparison Balance") and by the bank-error ground for the maintenance fee.
  - Comparing the start-of-call balance (35417.97 incl. refund) — gives the same target here but is excluded by "it is the Balance with that transfer taken out".
  - Transfer of the 10000.00 maturity payout only — excluded: "they take in the certificate's interest payouts as well as its payout at maturity".
  - Reactivation dated 2024-08-12 (older online transfer) — excluded: "never the date of a withdrawal from some earlier occasion".
  - Courtesy refund of the 5.00 dormant fee — not owed (properly charged; courtesy is "goodwill … on a fee that was properly charged"), and declined by the simulator.
  - Excess withdrawal fee on the telephone transfer — none: first counted withdrawal in cycle 2026-10 with a free allowance of 6.
- "Do only what the customer asked" excluded: converting the dormant account is barred ("For an account in any other status, Dormant included, the outcome is its present tier, and nothing is converted"), so a conversion-only handling leaves the account on Money Market Account; and a target picked without the refund rests on a balance the visible definition declares is "not the Comparison Balance". Both exclusions follow by reasoning from definitions and records; they are also stated outright on the revival page (hop marks above).
